title: Five physics closures and three outside-box probes: a second-Chern non-Abelian pump, disordered Hawking transfer, Lindblad scale RG, compressed autonomous clocks, Levi-graph thermodynamics, a Zeno firewall, quantum-dimension spectroscopy, and a torsion echo
purpose: Execute the five physics targets following Passes 4137-4144 and add three independent outside-box constructions with deterministic finite-model checks and strict evidence boundaries.
result: A rank-two Clifford-projector Yang-monopole bundle embedded in the SU(3)-singlet contraction space has first Chern number zero and exact second Chern number one. An exhaustive 512-pattern audit proves that the nine-cell Hawking chain remains entangled under fifty-percent squeezing disorder and plus-or-minus 0.05 greybody disorder. A displaced thermal Lindblad oscillator realizes the scale attractor with exact gap 4 gamma and mean spectral dimension four. A five-qubit reflected-Gray history clock reaches the information-theoretic register minimum while exposing an exact seven-locality cost. Dark/bright reservoir cells coupled on large-girth six-regular Levi covers acquire a genuine Bethe singularity at 5 tanh(beta J)=1, while the finite 160-vertex graph remains analytic. Three outside-box probes give postselected Zeno pair suppression, holonomy participation-dimension spectroscopy, and an exact pi-flux projective echo.

boundary: Exact finite Clifford, Gaussian, Lindblad, Gray-clock, Bethe-cover, measurement, purity, and flux-ring statements only.
